title: Greek-Style Stifado Emmental Paninis
description: A twist on classic Italian paninis, using Greek stifado sauce and rich emmental cheese for a unique flavor combination.
instructions: Butter one side of each bread slice.
Place a slice of bread, butter side down, in the panini press.
Top with a slice of emmental cheese, a few slices of ham, a spoonful of stifado sauce, and a handful of arugula.
Place another slice of bread, butter side up, on top.
Cook for 4-5 minutes, or until the bread is toasted and the cheese is melted.
